risks.title: Intense competition in the video game industry
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions the intense and fast-moving nature of the video game market, emphasizing that success depends on anticipating trends. Competition is a key industry factor, with players having greater financial resources.

risks.title: Dependence on distribution platforms
risks.score_rationale: EA relies heavily on partners such as Sony and Microsoft for console distribution, and Apple/Google for mobile. These agreements are subject to unilateral changes and can be terminated on short notice, directly impacting revenues. Direct sales represent 39% (Sony) and 17% (Microsoft) of total revenues in 2025.

risks.title: Rapid technological evolution and AI
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights the need to invest in R&D to keep pace with technological advancements, particularly AI, to remain competitive. Failure to adapt quickly could harm product quality and innovation.

risks.title: Complex and evolving regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: EA is subject to complex and changing laws worldwide regarding data protection, privacy, online safety, and business models (games with virtual items). Regulatory uncertainty may impact operations and revenues.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: EA relies on intellectual property (IP) but faces challenges in protecting it, particularly in certain Asian countries where laws are less protective or poorly enforced. IP-related litigation can be costly and damage reputation.

risks.title: Reliance on key franchises and Ultimate Team
risks.score_rationale: EA's success largely depends on key franchises such as EA SPORTS FC and Madden NFL, and specifically on the Ultimate Team mode. A decline in popularity or issues with these modes/franchises would have a material impact. The 10-K confirms that Ultimate Team revenues are 'material to our business'.

risks.title: Security and reliability of technology infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: The growth of EA's digital business makes the company dependent on the reliability and security of its technology infrastructure. Abuse and security issues can affect player experience and reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: EA acknowledges the importance of rapid technological evolution, including AI, and emphasizes the need for significant R&D investment to integrate these innovations and maintain competitiveness, according to the 10-K.
